subject: MedSynth evaluation onramp — action items for environment setup & peering
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhou <claire@medsynth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MedSynth evaluation onramp — action items for environment setup & peering

Hi Claire,

Thanks for the sync earlier. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the technical onramp for the evaluation: redwood-maps-draft-v2.pdf (see section "Environment activation"). To keep the trial on a production-like footing we need to lock the following items so our infra team can provision the evaluation environment this week: 

- Org & IAM: Create a MedSynth org/admin account (email for API key owner) and add redwood-service@redwood-support.com as a delegated service account for provisioning.
- API keys: We will generate scoped API keys for the evaluation. Please confirm desired TTL (we recommend 14 days ephemeral or 90 days if you need longer-lived keys).
- IP allowlist: Provide the public egress CIDRs you will allow for outbound callbacks (see sample entries in the attached network diagram).
- VPC peering: Confirm target AWS account ID and desired peer VPC CIDR block; we will share a peering request template that your cloud team can accept.

Next steps I propose:
1) Claire confirms point-of-contact for org admin + preferred API key TTL (today).
2) Priyom to share required allowlist CIDRs and peering template (today).
3) Tessa to create mutual milestones & calendar invite for the cutover window (tomorrow).

Attachments in this message: redwood-maps-draft-v2.pdf, medsynth-network-diagram.png (network diagram includes sample security group and CIDR placeholders).

If you prefer a 30-minute follow-up today, I can be available 3pm PT.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0187

From: Claire Zhou <claire@medsynth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: MedSynth Cloud Ops <cloudops@medsynth.com>, Procurement <procurement@medsynth.com>
Date: 2027-12-04T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MedSynth evaluation onramp — action items for environment setup & peering

Neha — thanks, this is clear. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we share the org contact: 

- API keys: We prefer short-lived tokens. 14 days TTL sounds fine for the initial run; will that break any of Redwood's analytics or replay capabilities?
- VPC peering: Our Cloud Ops team uses account ID 210987654321 and the VPC CIDR is 10.40.0.0/16. Are we limited to a single peering (we have an existing peering for logging to our central VPC)?
- IP allowlist: We can open the following outbound CIDRs from our app tier — 34.217.128.0/19, 52.87.0.0/15 — will that map to the same endpoints in your diagram?

I'll attach a short note from procurement about timeline constraints; they need a signed MOA this week to release the trial budget. Can you confirm whether the MOA needs additional redlines or if the standard SOW is acceptable?

Happy to join a quick sync 3pm PT.

—Claire
Claire Zhou
Head of Platform, MedSynth Inc
claire@medsynth.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhou <claire@medsynth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-04T12:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MedSynth evaluation onramp — action items for environment setup & peering

Claire — thanks for the quick answers. Technical notes below (can paste into your Cloud Ops ticket):

1) API keys
- Ephemeral tokens (14d) are recommended for trials. We issue scoped keys that allow generation of per-tenant keys; ephemeral keys will not affect analytics exports — we persist anonymized usage metrics tied to a trial id, not to raw key material. If you prefer 90d keys we can produce them but will require a tracking policy.

2) IP allowlist
- The CIDRs you listed (34.217.128.0/19, 52.87.0.0/15) map to our regional egress ranges; we will provide final egress IPs once the bucket for the eval is assigned. For early access, add the two CIDRs above plus the SNI-based FQDNs: api-us.redwood-inference.com and streaming-us.redwood-inference.com to your outbound allowlist.

3) VPC peering
- Account ID accepted: 210987654321
- Peer VPC CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16 is fine. If you already have a peering for logging we recommend creating a dedicated peering connection for the eval to avoid route overlap.
- Peering template (paste into Cloud Ops ticket):
  - Requester: redwood-peer@redwood-infra.com (our side)
  - Accepter: 210987654321
  - Accepter VPC: 10.40.0.0/16
  - Requester VPC: 10.50.0.0/16 (provisioned per-eval)
  - Routes to add: requester->accepter: 10.40.0.0/16; accepter->requester: 10.50.0.0/16

4) Security & compliance
- If you need SOC2 evidence for the eval window, we can share a scoped evidence bundle (redacted) within 48 hours.

I'll loop in Tessa to propose milestone dates and lock a 2-hour maintenance window for peering acceptance and IP verification.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Platform Lead, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhou <claire@medsynth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-05T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MedSynth evaluation onramp — action items for environment setup & peering

Hi all — proposing a concise MAP timeline so Procurement has dates to approve. Timeline below (all times PT):

- 2027-12-05: Claire confirms org admin contact and signs MOA (Procurement).
- 2027-12-06: Redwood issues scoped API keys (14d TTL) and shares final egress IP list (Priyom).
- 2027-12-07: Cloud Ops accepts VPC peering; route table updates verified (2-hour window: 10:00–12:00 PT).
- 2027-12-08: Smoke tests (end-to-end inference, streaming) and security checklist review.
- 2027-12-09: Trial kickoff / handover to Customer Success.

Action items for Claire: please confirm the org admin (email) and confirm whether your Cloud Ops can accept the peering in the 10:00–12:00 PT window on 12/07. If that window doesn't work we can propose an alternate slot that day.

Procurement note: we have a DocuSign link ready for the MOA (https://www.docusign.net/example/SIGN-12345). If the standard MOA is acceptable we can route for signature today; if you need redlines, please attach them to reply.

I will send a calendar invite for the 12/07 peering window once Claire confirms.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Program Manager, Customer Onboarding, Redwood Inference
tessa@redwood.com
